title: They control the narrative. God controls the outcome. ⚔️
paragraphs: They control the narrative. God controls the outcome. ⚔️
Stop fighting to clear your name with people who benefit from dirtying it. When you walk away from toxicity, expect the fire. But remember: the fire doesn't burn the Warrior; it refines them.
Keep stepping. God knows the full story.
📖 Isaiah 43:2: "When you walk through the fire, you shall not be burned, nor shall the flame scorch you."
Type "I AM WALKING FORWARD" if you are done looking back. 🔥
